claims.quote: The redspot dwarf cichlid, Apistogramma alacrina, is from the Río Guaviare (Orinoco) and Río Orteguaza (Amazon) drainages in Colombia.
Described from the Río Ariari within the Río Guaviare drainage, Meta Department, central Colombia, the Guaviare forming part of the much larger Río Orinoco system.
